item.title: Personal Finance (1): Why Asset Allocation Matters
item.description: Until six months ago my entire financial strategy was: salary in, rent out, the rest sits in a checking account at 0.2%. I write distributed systems for a living, but I had never once thought seriously about where my money should live. I’m not a CFA and this isn’t a finance blog — it’s an engineer writing down a framework as he builds it, because I know a lot of engineers with the same blind spot.
